text.en: The ocean floor is basically a flat, featureless basin, since it's covered by water and hidden from view -- in reality, the seafloor has more dramatic topography than the continents: mid-ocean ridges form the longest mountain range on Earth, and ocean trenches (like the Mariana Trench) reach deeper below sea level than Mount Everest rises above it.
text.et: Merepõhi on sisuliselt lame, tunnusteta bassein, kuna see on veega kaetud ja vaate eest peidus -- tegelikult on merepõhjal dramaatilisem topograafia kui mandritel: keskookeani seljandikud moodustavad Maa pikima mäeahelikku ning ookeanikraavid (nagu Mariaani kraav) ulatuvad meretasemest sügavamale, kui Mount Everest sellest kõrgemale kerkib.
